draft3Experiment.scope: The retry also lowers the advertised context limit; not a direct 256K replacement or a single-variable ablation.
draft3Experiment.conclusion: Not recommended as a replacement for draft7 at 256K. Same 3.06 GiB/GPU KV fails the 256K startup capacity check; 160K retry completes 128K but does not improve decode. Draft length, graph size and max length all changed, so this is not a single-variable ablation.
